follow-up time: 20±6 weeks for women with type 2 diabetes mellitus compared with 9±4 weeks for women with gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: 103 pregnant women with type 2 diabetes or gestational diabetes enrolled in a perinatal diabetes program
finding: Adherence to glucose monitoring recommendations was lower in pregnant women with type 2 diabetes compared to those with gestational diabetes, and every 10% increase in adherence was associated with a 15-20% decrease in the odds of cesarean delivery, neonatal hypoglycemia, and large-for-gestational-age infants.
mod_finding: For every 10% increase in adherence to testing recommendations, the odds of cesarean delivery decreases by 15-20%.
